subject: [PATCH v4 14/19] selftests/mm: run every supported collapse order by default

2026-08-15.patch_summary: This patch modifies the khugepaged selftest to run every supported collapse order by default, rather than only running a single specified order. The -c option is still available, but it now specifies what is wrong instead of printing usage text. The test also runs the mTHP cases once per supported anon THP order below the PMD when -c is absent. This change allows for more comprehensive testing and reduces the number of test invocations required.
